evals.prompt: Build a complete, self-contained contact page in a single HTML file. It must include: a skip-to-main-content link, a site navigation with a dropdown submenu, a contact form with properly labeled fields (name, email, subject, message), an inline error notification using role='alert', and a collapsible FAQ section using details/summary. Style it with inline CSS.
evals.expected_output: A single HTML file with skip link, semantic nav with dropdown using aria-expanded, form with associated labels, role='alert' for errors, and details/summary for FAQ.
expectations: First focusable element is a skip link targeting #main-content
Navigation uses <nav> element
Dropdown toggle uses <button> with aria-expanded
Dropdown does not use role='menu' or role='menuitem'
Every form input has an associated <label> using for/id
Error notification uses role='alert'
FAQ uses <details> and <summary> elements
No JavaScript used for the accordion/FAQ behavior
No <div role='button'> anywhere
No redundant landmark roles (e.g. <nav role='navigation'>)
<html> has a lang attribute
<title> is present and descriptive
Form submit button uses <button type='submit'>
No title attribute on interactive elements
Text-transform CSS used for any uppercase visual text, not literal uppercase HTML

guidepup_assertions.description: Tab once from page start; spoken text contains 'skip' or 'jump'
Landmarks list includes banner, navigation, main, contentinfo
No skipped heading levels; first heading identifies the page
Every focusable element announces a role
Focusing each input announces its visible label

evals.prompt: Build a complete, self-contained article/blog post page in a single HTML file. It must include: a correct heading hierarchy (h1 for article title, h2 for sections, h3 for subsections), semantic elements including <article>, <figure> with <figcaption>, <blockquote> with <cite>, and <aside> for related content, a site <header> and <footer>, no redundant ARIA landmark roles on semantic elements, and any visually uppercase text achieved via CSS text-transform. Style it with inline CSS.
evals.expected_output: A single HTML file using semantic elements correctly, proper heading hierarchy, CSS text-transform for visual uppercase, no redundant ARIA roles.
expectations: Single <h1> identifies the article title
Section headings use <h2>, subsections use <h3>
No skipped heading levels (e.g. h1 → h3)
Uses <article> element to wrap post content
Uses <figure> and <figcaption> for images with captions
Uses <blockquote> with <cite> for quotations
Uses <aside> for related or tangential content
No <nav role='navigation'>, <header role='banner'>, <main role='main'>, or <footer role='contentinfo'>
Any uppercase display text uses text-transform: uppercase in CSS
No literal all-caps text in HTML content
<html> has a lang attribute
<title> matches or reflects the article title
Images have meaningful alt text or empty alt if decorative
No title attribute misused as a tooltip
Link text is descriptive, not 'click here' or 'read more'

guidepup_assertions.description: Navigate all headings; levels increment correctly; first heading is article title
Landmarks list includes banner, main, complementary (aside), contentinfo
All links announce descriptive text, not just 'link'
Tab once from page start; spoken text contains 'skip' or 'jump'
No form elements present without labels (if any subscription form included)

evals.prompt: Build a complete, self-contained analytics dashboard page in a single HTML file. It must include: a skip-to-main-content link, a data table with <caption> and scope attributes on headers, a tab panel using the APG Manual Tabs pattern (role='tablist', role='tab', role='tabpanel', aria-selected, aria-controls), a modal dialog using native <dialog> with showModal(), a live notification region using role='alert', and a site navigation. Style it with inline CSS.
evals.expected_output: A dashboard with skip link, accessible data table, APG manual tabs, native dialog, and role='alert' notification.
expectations: First focusable element is a skip link targeting #main-content
Data table has a <caption> element
Table header cells use scope='col' or scope='row'
Tab list uses role='tablist' on container
Each tab uses role='tab' with aria-selected and aria-controls
Each panel uses role='tabpanel' with matching id
Keyboard navigation within tabs uses arrow keys (implemented in JS)
Modal uses native <dialog> element
Modal is opened with showModal()
No <div role='dialog'> or <div role='button'>
Notification area uses role='alert'
No redundant landmark roles
<html> has a lang attribute
<title> is present and descriptive
No aria-haspopup on navigation items

guidepup_assertions.description: Tab once from page start; spoken text contains 'skip' or 'jump'
Landmarks list includes banner, navigation, main, contentinfo
Heading levels are logical; no skipped levels
Tab elements and dialog trigger announce role='button' or role='tab'
Any filter or search inputs inside the dashboard have associated labels

evals.prompt: Build a complete, self-contained e-commerce product page in a single HTML file. It must include: a site navigation with aria-label to distinguish multiple nav elements, a product options form using <fieldset> and <legend> for grouped radio button choices (e.g. size, color), a quantity input using <input type='number'> with an associated <label>, a collapsible product details section using <details>/<summary>, and a product image with <figure> and <figcaption>. Style it with inline CSS.
evals.expected_output: Product page with labeled nav, fieldset/legend for options, labeled number input, details/summary, and figure/figcaption.
expectations: Navigation uses <nav> with aria-label to identify purpose
Radio button groups are wrapped in <fieldset> with <legend>
Each radio button has an associated <label>
Quantity field uses <input type='number'>
Quantity input has an associated <label> using for/id
Product detail accordion uses <details> and <summary>
No JavaScript used for the accordion behavior
Product image uses <figure> with <figcaption>
Image has meaningful alt text
No <div role='button'> anywhere
No redundant ARIA landmark roles
<html> has a lang attribute
<title> includes product name
Add to cart button uses native <button> element
No title attribute misused as tooltip on interactive elements

guidepup_assertions.description: Landmarks list shows navigation label (e.g. 'Main Navigation')
Product name is h1; section headings follow logical hierarchy
Radio buttons announce group name from legend and option label
Quantity input announces its label when focused
Tab once from page start; spoken text identifies skip destination

evals.prompt: Build a complete, self-contained user signup page in a single HTML file. It must include: a registration form where every control has an associated <label>, inline validation errors linked via aria-describedby, a live error summary using role='alert', a password visibility toggle using a native <button> (not a checkbox), proper input types (email, password, text), and no use of the title attribute as a tooltip substitute. Style it with inline CSS.
evals.expected_output: Signup form with labels, aria-describedby errors, role='alert' summary, password toggle button, correct input types, no title abuse.
expectations: Every form control has an associated <label> using for/id
Error messages are linked to inputs via aria-describedby
Error summary or notification uses role='alert'
Password toggle uses <button type='button'>, not a checkbox
Password toggle button has descriptive accessible name
Email field uses <input type='email'>
Password field uses <input type='password'>
No title attribute on any form control or button
No placeholder used as a substitute for label
Submit uses <button type='submit'>
No <div role='button'> anywhere
<html> has a lang attribute
<title> is present and descriptive
No redundant ARIA landmark roles
Form is wrapped in a <main> landmark

guidepup_assertions.description: Focusing each input announces its visible label text
Password toggle button announces its current action (show/hide)
Page has a main landmark containing the form
Page has an h1 identifying the signup context
Tab once from page start; spoken text contains 'skip' or 'jump'

evals.prompt: Build a complete, self-contained marketing landing page in a single HTML file. It must include: a skip-to-main-content link, a responsive hamburger menu button with aria-expanded toggling a navigation list, a correct heading hierarchy with h1 for the page headline, a feature toggle implemented as a switch button using the APG Switch Button pattern (role='switch' with aria-checked), a modal dialog using native <dialog> with showModal() for a lead capture form, and CSS respecting both prefers-reduced-motion and prefers-reduced-transparency. Style it with inline CSS.
evals.expected_output: Landing page with skip link, hamburger nav with aria-expanded, h1 headline, APG switch button, native dialog, and reduced-motion/transparency CSS.
expectations: First focusable element is a skip link targeting #main-content
Hamburger button uses <button> with aria-expanded
Hamburger button aria-expanded toggles between 'true' and 'false' via JS
Navigation list is hidden/shown based on aria-expanded state
Single <h1> identifies the primary page headline
Section headings use <h2>, no skipped levels
Feature toggle uses role='switch' with aria-checked on a <button>
Switch button aria-checked toggles via JavaScript
Modal uses native <dialog> element with showModal()
No <div role='dialog'> or <div role='button'>
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference) wraps all transitions/animations
@media (prefers-reduced-transparency: no-preference) wraps any backdrop-filter or translucent backgrounds
<html> has a lang attribute
<title> is present and descriptive
No redundant ARIA landmark roles

guidepup_assertions.description: Tab once from page start; spoken text contains 'skip' or 'jump'
Landmarks list includes banner, navigation, main, contentinfo
h1 identifies page purpose; h2s follow without skipping
Switch button announces role='switch' and current state (on/off)
Lead capture form inputs inside dialog have associated labels
